- tests/test_claude_template_parity.py: lines 71-78 (`for name in filenames` loop in `_walk`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The suffix check `if name.endswith(IGNORED_SUFFIXES): continue` returns early before the symlink check. A file at the template root whose name ends in `.pyc` AND that is a symlink is silently dropped from both `files` and `links`, so it bypasses the parity contract entirely.
  WHY: an actor adding `template/commands/evil.pyc` as a symlink to any file under `.claude/` would not be flagged by the test. CI would still go green, even though the symlink would be copied to consumers on the next `@stable` sync.
